High Fidelity’s September 1958 review lists the exact Monitor MC 2013 programme, pianist and retail price, establishing commercial publication by that date. The former 50-year term expired before the 2013 extension. This is the repository’s eu-published-before-1963 basis, not an Archive Creative Commons grant. United States recording rights are not established.
